review_method: GPT-6.1 Sol visually inspected enlarged source-image sheets and ambiguous originals, selected diverse entries, and manually authored independent prompt fields. No automated recaptioning was used for the selected records.
selection_coverage: Eight outfit categories; garment layers, cuts, materials, asymmetric details, footwear and accessories; four hairstyle-length groups with varied cuts and expressions.
source_images: Images remain on the original gallery hosts and are downloaded on demand; no gallery image files are redistributed.
provenance: Original captions remain in source_description/source_hair_description fields. Source IDs, URLs and image hashes are retained.
